cases.reason: Format 1 of this rule DEFINES the term qualified-data-name-with-subscripts, and 2002 Annex A names exactly that term (identifier Format 2) as referring to cd-name. In 2002 qualified-data-name-1 is defined by 8.4.1.1, whose qualifier includes a cd-name, so this rule governs subscripted table elements of a record under a CD (e.g. CIN-T OF CIN (CIN-I OF CIN)). The reader judged 8.4.1.1 and 8.4.2.1 communication-reach on the same Annex A line, but 8.4.2.1's reach runs THROUGH this rule; the NOTE ('shown for context') does not move the term's definition out of this clause, and Annex A's list is known to be incomplete. The 2023 row's tests cannot show a CD item. Compiler correct at 2002: probe output T=Z (subscripted CD table by index and literal); refused at 2023 (COBOL0902).
